description: Zyphra Technologies is a San Francisco-based AI lab that builds open-weights models and runs Zyphra Cloud, an inference platform. Its speech product is the ZONOS text-to-speech family with zero-shot voice cloning, released under Apache-2.0 on Hugging Face and served through an OpenAI-compatible speech API priced per UTF-8 byte of input text.
name: Zyphra
